name: Haku
source:
Likes: Humans, fine weather, lotuses (the plant)
Dislikes: Rain
Favorite food: Green tea
Disliked food: Coffee

A [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitsune]kitsune[/url] living in the 'Merchant's Town' one of the 'other worlds' to which [url=/c1792]Yuuma[/url] and the other travel regularly. She is a fortune teller who is good at predicting the weather.

[spoiler] She is [url=/c2002]Shigure[/url]'s daughter and is [url=/c1882]Kyou[/url]'s brother's lover.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://clephasstomach.blogspot.com/2011/08/review-irotoridori-no-sekai.html?zx=e598a7ae68f2a673]Clephas' review[/url].]
